messages:
anya: Heads-up — planned maintenance tonight: staggered powercap taper + rolling GPU node reboots across us-east1 and apac-west1. Window 03:00–04:30 UTC. Aim: reconcile thermal spikes and clear flaky NIC firmware before the next traffic peak. Minimal tenant eviction target.

mike: ETA on max concurrent capacity loss? any tenants on reserved pools that need handoff?

anya: Targeting <6% global GPU capacity reduction at any time. We'll avoid reserved pools; Jordan will coordinate reserved customer sticky lanes if needed. Primary impact: interruptible pools and autoscale-friendly slots.

jordan: I'll post a list of reserved tenants we'll keep pinned. Also can we limit batch-size for inference routing during the window?

anya: Yes — routing policy set to degrade to smaller batch sizes and prefer hot-pinned caches. Config snippet:

```
# temporary routing override
route: prefer: dedicated-hot, fallback: batch-small
batch_size: max 8
kv_cache: seed=true
```

sree: Ops-bot — please create a follow-up incident stub and annotate affected capacity metrics.

ops-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2026-178912 (label: nightly-powerharmonize). Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2026-178912

lina: Any special rollback triggers? e.g., sustained latency > 200ms for 10m, or error rate spike?

anya: Rollback triggers:
- 10m p95 gen latency > 200ms for critical routes
- 3%+ 5m error-rate increase for user-facing APIs
- sustained node OOMs or high NIC drop counts
If triggered, we abort reboots and start capacity backfill using warm spare pool.

mike: For node cordon/drain commands, prefer this sequence?

anya: Yep —
1) mark node N drain
2) move critical containers off N (graceful 60s)
3) restart NIC firmware
4) reboot GPU processes (not whole host unless needed)
5) verify perf and uncordon

jordan: I'll handle customer comms for the reserved accounts and set a canary tag for one small tenant to validate the sequence first.

lina: I'll watch the SLO dashboards and be on-call for rollback decision. :thumbsup:

sree: ops playbook reminder: include command to re-provision ephemeral instances for spot backfill: `provisioner replace --tag ephemeral-nightly --max 50`

anya: Thanks — final checklist:
- Jordan: reserved tenant list + canary (in 30m)
- Ops-bot: incident + dashboard annotations (done)
- Lina & Mike: SLO monitoring and rollback guardrails
- Sree: provisioning hook and spot backfill script ready

mike: :thumbsup: sounds good. I'll be online at 02:50 UTC to help with mid-window checks.

anya: Great — we'll kick at 03:00 UTC. Ping here when canary completes.
